image.description: Image data blob. Max 2MB (2,000,000 bytes) per image.

altText.description: Optional alt-text or accessibility description for the image.

primary.description: Optional primary/hero image, when one is designated. At most one primary is structurally guaranteed by this being a scalar field rather than a per-item flag.

secondary.description: Additional images, in display order after the primary image if one is present.

images.description: An optional primary/hero image plus optional additional images.
